card.name: The word dose after a qualifier
card.fires_on: The noun dose or dosage (also scan delay) right after a modifier such as starting, current, appropriate or individualization of, in dosing instructions. It sets up what is to be decided or adjusted.

card.writes: It favors words about setting or adjusting parameters, such as parameters, adjustments and the Chinese words for formulating.
card.plain: It fires on the word dose when a label talks about which dose to start with or how to adjust it.
